summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. (Vivo) filed a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing its board's approval of R$450,000,000 in gross interest on capital (IoC), a Brazil-specific shareholder distribution equivalent to a dividend. The net amount is R$371,250,000 after 17.5% withholding tax, or R$0.14081834570 gross and R$0.11617513520 net per share. Shareholders of record October 26, 2026 qualify, with payment by April 30, 2027. The distribution counts toward the 2026 mandatory minimum dividend, subject to ratification at the 2027 ordinary general meeting. The active buyback may alter the per-share figure upon final verification of the shareholding position.
